# anthropic_organization (Data Source)

Retrieves details about the Anthropic organization associated with the configured Admin API key (`GET /v1/organizations/me`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the organization.
- `name` (String) Display name of the organization.
- `type` (String) Object type (`organization`).
